title: Scott Galloway's Predictions for 2026
channel: The Prof G Pod – Scott Galloway

excerpts.label: China dumps cheap AI, crashes US valuations
excerpts.insight: China will dump massive AI into US market. 90% of OpenAI for 30% of price = crushing value prop. DeepSeek already at 4% share from zero.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: UNDERWEIGHT NVIDIA/OPENAI. China AI dumping is accelerating. If you can get 90% capability at 30% price, that's game over for premium pricing.

excerpts.label: Data center bubble: 250 nuclear plants at $10T
excerpts.insight: Revenue projections imply 250 new nuclear plants at $10T. Nvidia's hometown data center empty awaiting power. 5-8 years to connect to grid.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: DATA CENTER BUILDOUT IS SIGNALING, NOT REALITY. Announced ≠ constructed. Power constraints kill the thesis. Underweight data center plays.

excerpts.label: AI bailout coming in 2026
excerpts.insight: Government will bail out AI via loan guarantees—effectively socialism for tech bros. Revenue projections require impossible infrastructure.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: WATCH FOR BAILOUT POSITIONING. When government steps in, it signals peak bubble. Don't be long infrastructure layer when music stops.

excerpts.label: Nvidia = Intel 1999
excerpts.insight: Nvidia market cap > Costco, BofA, IBM, Palantir, Exxon, Walmart, Netflix, Oracle, Home Depot, Salesforce COMBINED. Intel went $200B→$500B→$165B.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: NVIDIA 94% GPU SHARE IS UNSUSTAINABLE. Everyone developing competing chips. Market cap > Canada + UK + France + Germany + Italy combined.

excerpts.label: AI loses at infrastructure, wins at application
excerpts.insight: AI will lose market cap at infrastructure layer but gain at application layer—specifically autonomous and robotics. Amazon has 1M robots vs 400K rest of nation.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: LONG AMAZON, UBER, WAYMO. Application layer is undervalued. Amazon can double retail revenue by 2033 without adding employees. That's margin expansion.

excerpts.label: Never short Tesla—it's a meme stock
excerpts.insight: Wanted to short at $30, been wrong ever since. Tesla disconnected from fundamentals. Consider 2-3x leveraged Mag7 shorts as hedge instead.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: DON'T SHORT TESLA DIRECTLY—meme dynamics override fundamentals. Use 2-3x leveraged ETFs on Mag7 as portfolio hedge, not directional bet.

excerpts.pm_takeaway: BEHAVIORAL WATCH: synthetic relationships sequestering youth. Regulatory scrutiny coming. Character.AI engagement is addictive—93 min sessions.

excerpts.label: Take less risk with money, more with relationships
excerpts.insight: Young men misallocating risk to betting apps instead of real relationships. 50% men 18-49 have betting accounts. Get out of the house.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: FINAL INSIGHT: The best returns come from relationship risk, not screen risk. Gaming stocks (-38%) are casualties. Nothing wonderful happens without taking risks—but pick the right risks.
